text: And thus the meaning is fulfilled: by the word 'antaḥkaraṇa' (internal instrument), which denotes the mind, intellect, and ego, seven other internal elements of a person's process of experience are also indicated, namely: kala, time, destiny, knowledge, passion, nature, and quality. By the word 'dhīkarma', the five elements, their causes, and their subtle essences are intended.
